name: Muoi tom
summary: A jar the provincial homepage names beside bánh tráng phơi sương. The tourism information center calls it salty, spicy, and aromatic, and says it is eaten with fruit, rice paper, and other dishes. A mắm article lists muối ớt and muối tôm as two names. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Tây Ninh. The provincial homepage puts muối tôm on the OCOP line with the rice paper. No street for a seated meal was printed.
taste: The tourism information center calls muối tôm salty, spicy, and aromatic.
The mắm article lists muối ớt and muối tôm as two names beside bò tơ and the rice-paper roll. A recipe that separates those names was not printed.
howToEat: The tourism information center says eat it with fruit, with bánh tráng, and with other dishes. Carry the jar. It is not described as a bowl of its own.
A price is Check on arrival.
where: The province's specialty shelf. No eating street was named for the jar.
seoDescription: Muối tôm is salty, spicy, and aromatic, eaten with fruit and rice paper. Muối ớt is also named. A price is Check on arrival.
